scope: Pythia 1B: 18 fixed endpoint-selected Writer–Reader routes,19 checkpoints;complete C and Hplus
weighting: mean/std use every actual correct-minus-incorrect comparison with equal comparison weight;query_equal_mean is a separately named summary
normalization: Each term mean divided by its own comparison-weighted population standard deviation;these ratios are not additive
reference: C0=mean(C_D) over D=0..2047;Hplus0=mean(positive_part(sym(C_D))) over D=0..2047;actual candidate distances retained through R
